question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

The look in his eyes **shocks and scares me a lot. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"makes one's blood run cold"** means something** that shocks and scares someone a lot**. (किसी को बहुत चौंकाना और डराना)

 
 
• **Example: **The eerie sound of footsteps in the dark hallway **made her blood run cold.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In seventh heaven** (सातवें आसमान पर): Extremely happy.

 
 
• **Example:** She was in seventh heaven when she received the news of her promotion.
 
 
 
• **Sixth sense** (छठी इंद्री): An intuitive feeling or perception.
 
 
• **Example:** His sixth sense warned him of the impending danger.
 
 
 
• **Sugar rush** (शर्करा के सेवन के बाद अचानक ऊर्जा का बढ़ना): A sudden burst of energy after consuming sugary foods.
 
 
• **Example:** The children had a sugar rush after eating all the sweets at the party.

The correct answer is** Option 3.**
